observation: Provider code exchange stays server-side and returns only openid/unionid; resolve/enroll and runtime resolution precede storefront-only miniapp token issue.
Binding requires UUID challenge and local credential; registration hashes password/invite and registers/binds before session creation.
OTP challenge stores phone/code hashes and expiry; mobile and username registration validate invite/password and use private RPC.
Current-password verification is rate-limited audited then revokes/reissues session with verified timestamp.
Current full router rejects auth namespace and actual Storefront public router does not register these handlers.
